body.ruleText:
rule dac_gh_0030 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: Mass private repository clone or archive download - repo.download_zip / git.clone burst private"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0030"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1213.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "repo.download_zip" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "git.clone" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "repo.access" nocase)
    $name = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $name over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)

  condition:
    $e and $count > 20
}
